    def __init__(self):
        self.generation = 0
        self.rows = []
        self.decisions = {}
        self.busy = False
        self._status = {}  # generation -> status
        self._completed_pending = set()  # generations that completed and need fetch
        self._finished = set()  # generations that have been finished

    def start(self):
        self.generation += 1
        self.rows = []
        self.decisions = {}
        self.busy = True
        return self.generation

    def poll_status(self, generation, status):
        # Stale/duplicate statuses return False
        if generation != self.generation:
            return False
        
        # Store the status
        old_status = self._status.get(generation)
        self._status[generation] = status
        
        # If status hasn't changed, return False
        if old_status == status:
            return False
        
        # queued/running keep busy
        if status in ('queued', 'running'):
            return False
        
        # failed ends busy without fetching
        if status == 'failed':
            self.busy = False
            return False
        
        # completed - only the latest running generation transitioning to completed returns True ONCE
        if status == 'completed':
            # Mark that this generation needs to be fetched
            self._completed_pending.add(generation)
            return True
        
        return False

    def finish(self, generation, rows):
        # Accept only latest completed pending results once
        if generation != self.generation:
            return False
        
        if generation not in self._completed_pending:
            return False
        
        if generation in self._finished:
            return False
        
        # Copy rows
        self.rows = list(rows)
        self._finished.add(generation)
        self._completed_pending.discard(generation)
        self.busy = False
        return True

    def set_decision(self, job_id, value):
        self.decisions[job_id] = value"}}}]
